categories.main_business_segments: China Railway Construction Heavy Industry Corporation Limited (CRCHI) primarily operates in three main business segments: tunnel boring machines (TBM), rail transit equipment, and special professional equipment. The company designs, develops, manufactures, sells, leases, and services high-end equipment including tunnel boring machines, rail transit components such as turnouts and fasteners, and specialized construction and mining machinery. It also develops high-end agricultural machinery and intelligent construction equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: CRCHI focuses on advanced technologies including large-diameter shield machines, intelligent and automated tunneling equipment, digital twin technology, and integrated design-manufacturing-maintenance platforms. The company emphasizes original and integrated innovation, with proprietary core components like large-diameter main bearings, control systems, hydraulic pumps, and rock drilling machines. Production combines in-house manufacturing with outsourced collaboration, adopting digital transformation and smart manufacturing including 5G and industrial internet applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves key customers in railway construction, urban rail transit, mining, water conservancy, hydropower, and public infrastructure sectors. Major customers include large state-owned enterprises such as China Railway Construction Corporation and its subsidiaries. The products are used in domestic infrastructure projects like high-speed rail, metro, water diversion, and mining operations, as well as exported to over 50 countries globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: CRCHI operates primarily in China with significant domestic market penetration, especially in infrastructure-heavy regions. The company has expanded its overseas presence with regional hubs and warehouses in the UAE, Italy, and other countries, serving markets in Central Asia, Africa, Southeast Europe, and the Middle East. Overseas business accounted for over 14% of main business revenue in 2024, with exports to 50 countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: CRCHI operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain as a manufacturer and integrator of high-end construction and mining equipment. It controls key component production and assembly processes and provides after-sales services including leasing and maintenance. The company also acts as a supply chain leader by integrating upstream suppliers and managing strategic procurement alliances.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on high-end, intelligent, green, customized, refined, and globalized development. It pursues innovation-driven growth with heavy R&D investment (~9% of revenue), focusing on original innovation, digitalization, and smart manufacturing. Key R&D projects include ultra-large diameter TBMs, intelligent tunneling robots, core component localization, and new product lines in mining and agricultural machinery. CRCHI also emphasizes integration of AI, big data, and IoT technologies to enhance product intelligence and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: CRCHI generates revenue primarily through direct sales of equipment, including tunnel boring machines, rail transit components, and specialized machinery. It also earns income from leasing services of tunneling and special equipment. The company provides engineering and technical services, and receives government subsidies related to R&D and infrastructure projects. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance or as services are rendered.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CRCHI is a leading global player in tunnel engineering equipment, ranked among the top five worldwide and first in China’s specialized engineering machinery sector. It holds a dominant market share in full-face tunnel boring machines and specialized tunneling equipment. The company competes with other major domestic and international engineering machinery manufacturers, leveraging its technological innovation, product customization, and integrated service capabilities to maintain industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, CRCHI reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 10 billion, with a slight year-on-year increase of 0.19%. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 1.5 billion, a 5.37% decrease from the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 26.7 billion, growing 5% year-over-year. Operating cash flow improved significantly by 190.62%, reflecting enhanced collection efforts. Overseas business revenue grew by 122.48%, contributing 14% of total revenue, indicating strong growth in international markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CRCHI emphasizes its unique value through high-end, intelligent, and customized equipment solutions tailored for complex and extreme underground engineering environments. The company’s products feature advanced technologies such as ultra-large diameter TBMs, intelligent control systems, and integrated construction methods that improve safety, efficiency, and environmental sustainability. Its comprehensive lifecycle services, strong R&D capabilities, and global market reach differentiate it as a provider of turnkey solutions for strategic infrastructure projects.
